import re def extract_html_elements(document: str) -> list[str]: """ Return a list of all HTML tags found in the given document string. Parameters ---------- document : str The input HTML content to analyze. Returns ------- list[str] A list of strings, each string being an HTML tag (e.g., "
", "

", ""). """ # Ensure the input is a string; if not, convert it to an empty string. try: text = str(document) except Exception: return [] # Regular expression to match anything that starts with '<' and ends with '>' # but does not contain a newline inside the tag. This is a simple pattern # suitable for most typical HTML snippets. tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>\s]+(?:\s+[^>]+)?/>|<[^>]*?>', re.DOTALL) # Find all matches; if none, return an empty list. tags = tag_pattern.findall(text) return tags
